title: Life saver + a very needed update
body: I love this app, basically organizing my entire life there. I would very much like to ask for a fix or update. I am using this app on iOS so maybe it’s not the issue with everyone, but whenever I want to reorder sub-tasks, they sometimes go and promote themselves as primary tasks while I am reordering them, and it really bugs me that I have to be extra careful and sometimes it still happens. If it’s supposed to be a shortcut, it’s not a practical one. Please if you can sort this out it would be awesome!
author: anysiapop

title: Non-working widgets
